description: Estimates Base gas costs from current fees and priority-fee presets. Fixed gas units (100k simple, 250k complex, 180k liquidity) are typical assumptions, not transaction-specific estimates or quotes. Valid values: standard, high-mev (3x priority fee), low-gas (half); invalid values return HTTP 400 without charge. No transaction simulation, mempool observation, or MEV/sandwich-risk measurement. Costs $0.04 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

scenario.description: One of standard, high-mev, low-gas (default: standard)

name: mev-simulator
